David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Eliab_3: firstborn (1 Chronicles 2:13) son of Jesse (1 Samuel 16:6) brother of David
Jeroboam_1: Solomon's servant, son of Nebat, who rebelled against him (1 Kings 11:26), and was later made king of Israel (1 Kings 12:20)
Rehoboam_1: son of Solomon who became king after him (1 Kings 11:43)
Shemaiah_1: the man of God (1 Kings 12:22, 2 Chronicles 11:2)
Abijam_1: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam (1 Kings 14:31) [Abijah in 2 Chronicles 12:16]
Maacah_3: mother of Abijam (1 Kings 15:2) and Asa (1 Kings 15:10), daughter of Uriel_2 of Gibeah (2 Chronicles 13:2)
Abishalom_1: father of Maacah the mother of Abijam (1 Kings 15:2)
Mahalath_2: daughter of Jerimoth and Abihail and wife of Rehoboam (2 Chronicles 11:18)
Jeush_5: son of Rehoboam and Mahalath (2 Chronicles 11:18)
Shemariah_2: son of Rehoboam and Mahalath (2 Chronicles 11:18)
Zaham_1: son of Rehoboam and Mahalath (2 Chronicles 11:18)
Attai_3: son of Rehoboam and Maacah (2 Chronicles 11:20)
Ziza_2: son of Rehoboam and Maacah (2 Chronicles 11:20)
Shelomith_4: son of Rehoboam and Maacah (2 Chronicles 11:20)
